{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 50 H7 +0.025"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: 20mNcR5 # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2( 0.8) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 2.15 kg"}],"comment":"The ⌀50 H7 bore (D14) is a tight fit on a part that receives zinc plating per note N4, yet the drawing does not state whether the H7 tolerance applies before or after plating. Without this allowance the plated bore may be undersize and reject the mating bearing; the designer should add a note specifying if the H7 limit is pre- or post-plating, or adjust the dimension to account for coating thickness."
    ,"recommended_correction":"Add a note clarifying that the ⌀50 H7 tolerance applies after plating, or provide an adjusted pre-plate machining size that accounts for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D7","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: 20mNcR5 # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2( 0.8) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 2.15 kg"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 hole (D7) carries an ISO fit tolerance on a plated part (I.Z.B.P. finish per N4), but no provision is made for the plating thickness. Zinc buildup will reduce the effective bore diameter and can prevent assembly of the mating pin; the designer must specify whether the H7 applies before or after plating."
    ,"recommended_correction":"Add a note stating whether the ⌀8 H7 tolerance is before or after plating, or adjust the pre-plate size to allow for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D23","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 6 H7"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: 20mNcR5 # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2( 0.8) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 2.15 kg"}],"comment":"The ⌀6 H7 hole (D23) has an ISO fit tolerance on a part with I.Z.B.P. plating (N4), yet the drawing does not address plating thickness. The added coating will shrink the bore below its functional limit and interfere with the mating dowel or pin; the designer should clarify if the H7 is a pre- or post-plate requirement."
    ,"recommended_correction":"Specify whether the ⌀6 H7 tolerance applies before or after plating, or provide a pre-plate machining dimension that compensates for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
